seeds.context: DudeRobe is an online Shopify store offering 29 loungewear and robe products for men, women, kids, and families, priced between $25 and $339. The catalog includes bottoms, tees, robes, hoodies, and themed bundles such as family and couple sets. Materials used are polyester, rayon, and spandex, with most items featuring two pockets. The brand targets a mixed audience including sports fans, wellness enthusiasts, and family shoppers.
